# Copilot instructions

This repo uses a clean room: read the first section of [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md)
("Before anything else: the clean room") and follow it before doing any work.
Your first reply must tell the user about the clean room, say whether this
conversation already contains any of Roblox Studio's internals, and ask whether
this session is the reader or the writer. Full rules: docs/CLEANROOM.md.
